subject: Onboarding security sprint: SCIM/SAML, service accounts, and IP allowlist handover
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kapoor <alex.kapoor@larkspurhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Onboarding security sprint: SCIM/SAML, service accounts, and IP allowlist handover

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. Per our discussion, we want to run a focused onboarding security sprint next week to finish SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, IP allowlist, and service-account scaffolding so your security and platform teams can finish their checks before pilot. Proposed sprint window: Nov 9–12 (US PST).

To keep the sprint tight, please share the following by EOD Friday (Nov 6):
- SAML IdP metadata (XML) and the user attribute you want mapped to email/username.
- SCIM: list of attributes you currently provision (email, displayName, department, groups) and any custom attrs.
- IP ranges that need to be added to your allowlist (CIDR blocks).
- A short list of service accounts you want Redwood to create vs ones you'll manage.
- Primary technical contact for the cutover (name, phone, ok to share Zoom).

I've attached a short runbook (rwinf_onboarding_runbook_v1.pdf) that outlines the canary plan, rollback steps, and monitoring hooks. High level reminders in the runbook:
- Canary: 10% of auth flows for 48hrs before full switch.
- SCIM group sync cadence recommended: 15m for groups, 1h for user updates (adjustable).
- Service accounts: prefer RFC-3339 namespaced pattern: rwinf-larkspur-<env>-svc.

Let us know if that window works and if procurement needs to be included. We'll loop in our IAM engineer (Jonas) for the SAML metadata exchange and Monica will lead the SCIM mapping.

Best,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Alex Kapoor <alex.kapoor@larkspurhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Narayanan <priya.n@larkspurhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding security sprint: SCIM/SAML, service accounts, and IP allowlist handover

Ben —

Thanks, that plan looks good. Nov 9–12 works for engineering. I'll get the SAML metadata and a preliminary SCIM attribute list over by Friday. A couple notes from our side:
- Procurement is finalizing PO; expect paperwork next week but shouldn't block the sprint.
- We use Okta as IdP; our admins prefer exchanging metadata via a secure S3 link.
- IP ranges: we have two NAT clusters: 18.210.32.0/22 and 34.200.128.0/22, confirm whether you need both.

I'll also add our security lead (Priya) and she may ask for a brief SOC2 evidence list in advance.

—Alex
Platform Lead, Larkspur Health
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Kapoor <alex.kapoor@larkspurhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding security sprint: SCIM/SAML, service accounts, and IP allowlist handover

Alex —

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Quick checklist and owners so we start sprint-ready:

Pre-sprint (owner / due):
- SAML metadata upload to secure S3 link (Alex) / due Fri 2026-11-06 EOD
- SCIM attribute export (CSV) with current values and group membership examples (Alex) / due Fri 2026-11-06
- Confirm IP CIDRs for allowlist (Alex) / due Fri 2026-11-06
- Procurement PO or contact (Priya) / FYI to Ben

Runbook highlights (what we'll execute during Nov 9–12 sprint):
1) SAML exchange + test IdP in staging
   - Jonas will import IdP metadata, validate NameID format, and confirm assertion consumer URLs.
   - Test cases: login, group mapping via SAML assertion, and session timeout behavior.
2) SCIM provisioning mapping
   - We'll use the mapping in scim-attribute-map-larkspur.xlsx (attached). Key mappings: email->userName, displayName->displayName, dept->department, groups->groups.
   - Recommended group sync cadence: 15m for group deltas; fallback to full sync nightly.
   - We'll flag custom attributes; if you rely on custom attrs for entitlements, we recommend a one-off script to backfill before cutover.
3) Service accounts and secrets
   - Recommended naming: rwinf-larkspur-prod-svc-01 (production), rwinf-larkspur-stg-svc-01 (staging).
   - We will create short-lived API keys for in-flight operations; keys rotate automatically weekly. If you require HSM/KMS attestation, let us know so we can open the KMS integration ticket.
4) IP allowlist and networking
   - We'll stage using the two CIDRs you provided. During canary, traffic from only the staging CIDR will be allowed. After 48h pass, we add production CIDR and expand to full.
5) Observability and rollback
   - Monitoring: auth success rate, SCIM sync errors, 5xx surface rate. Alert thresholds: auth success drop >2% for 10m triggers incident.
   - Rollback: revert SAML to prior IdP metadata and disable SCIM provisioning for 1h window if critical errors observed.

Action items assigned in-line in the attached spreadsheet. If the owners above are correct I'll book the sprint calendar invite and a 30-minute pre-sprint checklist call on Nov 8 to validate staging credentials and test accounts.

Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: scim-attribute-map-larkspur.xlsx (mapping + example rows)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Kapoor <alex.kapoor@larkspurhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:58:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding security sprint: SCIM/SAML, service accounts, and IP allowlist handover

Thanks — all makes sense. Quick technical flags:
- Please confirm whether you’ll assert groups via SAML or rely solely on SCIM group sync. If groups come via SAML we’ll treat them as source-of-truth only for session assertions and still run SCIM for membership records.
- For the rolling canary, ensure test users include both admin and non-admin personas so we validate entitlements. Monica, I can provide a list of 6 test accounts by Friday.
- Networking: if you have downstream proxies that rewrite source IP, share a packet capture or proxy config; otherwise the CIDRs Alex gave are fine for our allowlist entries.

I’ll stand by for the SAML metadata S3 link and the SCIM CSV. Once we have both, I’ll queue the staging import and post a brief status update in the sprint calendar invite.

Jonas
Senior IAM Engineer | Redwood Inference
